checks: Clean production npm-start path serves healthy liveness with the generated standalone assets
Legacy courses load with every new corporate control switched off
An enabled employee/identity requirement blocks an unverified session
Learners and unassigned facilitators cannot approve employee identity
An authorised facilitator records employee identity, method and review evidence
Randomised assessment selection includes usable matching options while hiding all answer keys
Refresh preserves question order and a second browser cannot take over an active attempt
A second employee cannot read the first employee’s assessment session
Direct final submissions cannot bypass session ownership or the required camera checkpoint
Verified-session answers persist before submission and survive refresh
The server enforces expiry and a facilitator can extend an interrupted attempt with an audit reason
An extension adds fifteen minutes to an active deadline without shortening the time already granted
An enabled camera requirement keeps assessment controls locked until its checkpoint is captured
Prompted camera capture stores two protected images and immediately stops the camera stream
Camera evidence is private to the employee and authorised reviewers, with no public upload URL
Randomised MCQ and matching answers restore correctly in the mobile assessment after a page refresh
Production grading uses the stored randomised question snapshot and awards the correct result
A passing quiz does not release the credential while selected corporate verification is pending
Course moderators cannot publish identity or competency marking decisions
Oral meeting details are saved and stale review updates are rejected
Every selected competency must pass its own threshold even when the overall assessment score is high
Completed identity, camera, workplace, oral and competency reviews release the authorised credential
The employer report exports competency and identity evidence with CSV formula protection
Employee verification and facilitator review fit a phone viewport
The facilitator master switch reveals independent controls and does not enable any feature automatically
Courses without enabled controls make no corporate-session requests and never request webcam access
A later negative verification decision sends an issued credential for review
Even an administrator cannot restore the credential while a selected verification requirement remains unmet
A released evidence follow-up resumes in a new employee browser without losing its quiz grade or creating a timed exam
A reviewed accessible alternative satisfies the camera gate, and restoring a flagged credential still requires administrator review
Evidence downloads stop at the selected expiry even before the cleanup worker deletes the file
The evidence API bounds streamed request bodies even without a Content-Length header
Corporate learner, facilitator and default-course workflows render without browser page errors
environment: Node 22 local production standalone, isolated synthetic records. External AI disabled; mock LTI and Paystack only.
